renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: Make the hard handy and sweeten the bitter -- his recall alone is valiant: mind him, the lover's bane. Songs whose singable is the Tallest thrive; at his bare name the great bristle bright.

As thou, even thou, at the beyond: thy hosts rank and unrank triple worlds. Spell, spell-fit, spell-master -- hand the spell that spells me thine. Glow-built, vow-true, thyself in me, yet drifter called -- what dream is this, and how in thee? Unsnapped, unchurlish, single, sound: in thee stands the fortune of yielders.

Meet to smash sorrows, meet to deal boons -- or nay? Yon same is our pet, god over gods, bull-signed. For god-sight filmed, thy love is sovereign salve. Fear-free, bliss-stuffed, sole, unwasting: lodge that footing -- come, why dally? Ah, bottomless the drowning rounds; ah, the ferry-scheme -- some Arch, great Master.

paragraphs.text: Hard mode easy mode, bitter sweetened -- solo valiant recall: rate him, the love-killer. Anthems with the Tallest as hook thrive; bare name drops and titans get gooseflesh.

Thee as thee past the pale: thy legions deploy and dissolve triple sim. Charm, charm-spec, charm-lord -- pass the passkey that charms me yours. Glow-forged, vow-locked, thyself in me, yet tagged drifter -- what dream is this, and how in thee? Seamless, classy, single, sound: in thee vests the prize of the pledged.

Specced to nuke sorrows, specced to drop loot -- or nah? Yon same is the fave, god of gods, bull-flagged. For filmed god-vision thy love is top balm. Dreadless, bliss-jacked, solo, unwiped: install that state -- pull up, why dally? Ah, the drown-pool fathomless; ah, the ferry-scheme -- some Arch, big Master.
